notes.title: Artbook DLC now available!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25881614/66da99cb7dbc104bfb2700c54a001f6044881996.png[/img]
The artbook for the Ne no Kami series is now live! We highly recommend that fans of the series check it out! This artbook contains explicit and uncensored content so please keep that in mind! Save 10% when you make your purchase before June 14th.

[i]Ne no Kami - The Two Princess Knights of Kyoto Artbook contains illustrations, design work and other information about the Ne no Kami universe. Featuring the designs of character designer, Hatachi, dive into the lore of this yuri franchise.[/i]

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] 72 pages of content including over 30 pages in full color.
[*] Includes a mini manga illustrated by bokkun
[*] Includes a mini light novel featuring characters from the franchise
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1096830/Ne_no_Kami__The_Two_Princess_Knights_of_Kyoto__Art_Book/
